# Criticality_Threshold

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A specific value of the weight norm or normalization scale beyond which the training dynamics become unstable, leading to loss spikes. Identifying this threshold is key for setting safe hyperparameters in in-network learning systems, where real-time adaptation must avoid catastrophic failures.
